summary: Framework-independent frontend helpers and product adapters. Product state mutations use the existing Host APIs.

key_files.canvasElementReconciliation.ts: Projects fixed Action capsule bounds without mutating the received node, and reuses unchanged frontend nodes/edges across snapshots. Stored historical dimensions are not rewritten during reads.
key_files.canvasNodeOrder.ts: Parent ordering, structural-change classification and z-index projection. User resize changes are identified by ReactFlow gesture metadata; ResizeObserver measurements stay view-local.
key_files.loroNodeSync.ts: Collects layout-only patches and submits them through useLoroSync.applyLayout. Validates the whole batch, including whole-node downstream immutability, on a detached Project mutation and publishes one complete update through Canvas operations. Rejected layouts leave the live replica unchanged.
key_files.syncRecovery.ts: IndexedDB recovery archive used by useLoroSync and SyncRecoveryDialog. Atomically stores a rejected local Loro snapshot and latest-backup pointer before removing only that project's automatic-sync cache. Resolves only after transaction completion; abort preserves the prior cache and backup.
key_files.generatorDraftEditor.ts: Serial native Generator draft edits. Each request uses the previous Host acknowledgement for CAS; flush waits for queued edits and propagates failure. A failed editor must be replaced after an explicit fresh read. State and input updater functions run against the previous acknowledged input list in the same queue as state edits. Unchanged state and inputs reuse the current revision. Native ActionBadge prompt/model/parameter edits use this queue, and Run waits for its acknowledged revision. Verified against the live Host and actual GUI. The exported acknowledgement parser also validates native copy responses. Full draft updater transactions derive state and inputs from the same acknowledged revision. Run preparation resolves current Definition identity inside the edit queue. Contract changes force a new CAS revision while preserving authored state/inputs; unchanged contracts reuse the head. Lookup, CAS, or acknowledgement contract mismatch stops preparation.
key_files.timelineDsl.ts: Timeline persistence normalization; retain immutable Project Asset identity while removing transient delivery fields.
key_files.createCanvasModelDraft.ts: GUI Model and mapped Action Card creation adapters. Send native state and optional grouped Canvas placement through one existing Host Generator creation request, validate the acknowledgement, and never submit a Run. Card forms preserve flat plugin state and actionCardId instead of inventing a Model identity.
key_files.modelPromptContent.ts: Frontend re-export of shared Model ordered prompt operations.
key_files.modelPromptMentions.ts: Frontend re-export of shared Model mention and text-reference picker edits. Applied text inputs pin exact Document revisions; Host Canvas prompt updates use the same compiler.
key_files.connectNativeModelInput.ts: Serial native Asset connection authoring through existing Generator read/advance APIs. Freezes the selected media or exact Document revision before queueing, and the Host commits inputs plus Canvas edges atomically. Models use shared slot, prompt, text, and keyframe transformations. Mapped Action Cards use their declared media and plain-text Document ports. Removing a Canvas edge uses the existing Host Canvas DELETE route in useLoroSync so other connections retain the input.
key_files.modelMediaInput.ts: Frontend re-export of shared-types Model role selection, also used by Host legacy migration.
key_files.addCanvasGraph.ts: Atomically publishes a copied Canvas graph through shared Canvas operations on a detached mutation. Rejects duplicate identities and edges outside the copied graph; prevents Host admission before input edges exist.
key_files.logger.ts: Browser adapter for shared-runtime/logging. Stable module loggers, opt-in clash.logLevel and pagehide summary flush; no separate web.log file.
key_files.useDirectorCodeSources.ts: Loads exact Document revisions selected by the Director component registry; errors and source loading gate the viewport.
key_files.marketplaceCatalog.ts: Validates untrusted marketplace entries and retains only installation descriptors matching their product kind, runtime and identity; shared by cloud/local loaders.
